user.title: Connect to ZoneMinder
user.description: Point Home Assistant at your ZoneMinder server. Monitors are discovered automatically.

data_description.backend: zm-api is the standalone REST server and is the better choice where it is available. Pick the built-in API to talk to a stock ZoneMinder install.
data_description.host: For zm-api, the address and port it listens on, such as http://192.168.1.10:{default_port}. For the built-in API, the ZoneMinder web address including its path, such as http://192.168.1.10/zm.
data_description.mqtt_enabled: Motion then updates in under a second instead of on the polling interval. Needs the MQTT integration and MQTT switched on in ZoneMinder.

reconfigure.title: Change ZoneMinder settings
reconfigure.description: Update the address or credentials of this ZoneMinder server.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check the address and port, and that ZoneMinder is running.
error.invalid_auth: That username and password were rejected.
error.api_error: The server answered but rejected the request. Check that the API is enabled and the account has permission.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. The log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This ZoneMinder server is already set up.
abort.wrong_server: That address belongs to a different ZoneMinder server. Add it as a new integration instead.

data_description.mqtt_topic: Leave blank to use the prefix ZoneMinder reports (ZM_MQTT_TOPIC_PREFIX).
data_description.scan_interval: Leave blank to poll every 5 minutes with MQTT on, or every 30 seconds without it.
data_description.web_url: Where the ZoneMinder web interface lives, used for the links on each device. The zm-api server usually runs on a different port.

trigger_event.name: Trigger event
trigger_event.description: Forces a monitor into alarm, which makes ZoneMinder start recording an event.

cause.name: Cause
cause.description: Text stored against the event, so you can tell later what set it off.

cancel_event.name: Cancel event
cancel_event.description: Clears an alarm that was forced with Trigger event.

ptz.name: Move camera
ptz.description: Sends a pan, tilt, zoom or focus command to a camera ZoneMinder can control.

command.name: Command
command.description: What the camera should do. Continuous movements keep going until you send Stop moving.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Which stored position to recall. Only used with the Go to preset command.

set_monitor_state.name: Set monitor mode
set_monitor_state.description: Changes what a monitor captures, analyses and records. Any setting you leave out is kept as it is.

capturing.name: Capturing
capturing.description: Whether ZoneMinder pulls video from the camera.

analysing.name: Analysing
analysing.description: Whether ZoneMinder looks for motion. Motion sensors stay off while this is off.

recording.name: Recording
recording.description: Whether ZoneMinder writes events to disk, and whether it does so constantly or only on motion.

decoding.name: Decoding
decoding.description: How much of the stream ZoneMinder decodes. Lower settings use less CPU.

no_targets.message: No ZoneMinder monitors were targeted. Pick a camera entity or a monitor device.

preset_required.message: The 'Go to preset' command needs a preset number.

mqtt_not_publishing.title: ZoneMinder is not publishing events over MQTT
mqtt_not_publishing.description:
Home Assistant is listening on `{topic}` for {name}, but no monitor has MQTT switched on, so motion will only update when the integration next polls.

In ZoneMinder, turn on MQTT under Options > MQTT, then enable it on each monitor under its MQTT tab.

no_internal_url.title: ZoneMinder cameras need an internal URL
no_internal_url.description:
{name} streams video through Home Assistant, which needs to know its own address to build the stream URL.

Set an internal address under Settings > System > Network, then reload the integration.
